name: 2019-1c-parcial2
title: Personal and Team Calendars
description: Individual calendars grouped into a hierarchy of team calendars, holding one-off and periodically repeating events, that answer whether a time span is free and find the first available spot of a given duration within a time-of-day range and a date range, scanning hour by hour. The student must build the model from scratch with TDD.

design.notes: A composite of calendars, a polymorphic event hierarchy (one-off vs repeating with optional end) and a nested date/time search over intervals built with the Chalten date library; the difficulty is keeping the spot-finding loop expressed with interval protocol rather than manual counters.
